notes: Validated against Trausch et al. Structure 2011 (doi:10.1016/j.str.2011.06.007). 3SD3 has U25C mutation in aptamer 1 (does not affect aptamer 2 / site 3WJ). FFO is folinic acid / (6S)-5-formyl-THF (MW 473). TWO BINDING SITES in the THF riboswitch aptamer: Site 3WJ (main): pteridine stacks between G26 and G54; C53 and U25 form H-bonds to pteridine N2/N3 and N1/N8 edges respectively; G68 (bulged) stacks with the aminobenzoate benzene ring. Site PK (secondary): pteridine stacks on A8; U7, U35, U42 H-bond pteridine. Glutamate tail disordered — no specific contacts in either site.
